tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan rnam par bstan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo sarba buddha ye/ gdul bya'i phan bde'i padmo'i tshal/ /rgyas mdzad bskal pa bzang po yi/ /rgyal ba nyi ma stong phrag dag /ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan brjod bya/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sedge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rab gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me tog gnyis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /7 sangs rgyas rgyu skar bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ded dpon la= /sangs rgyas lag chen la= /sangs rgyas stobs chen la= /sangs rgyas rgyu skar rgyal po la=/sangs rgyas rtsi smin la= /sangs rgyas snyan pa'i tog la= /sangs rgyas 'od chen la= /sangs rgyas grol ba'i phung po la= /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la=/ /7 sangs rgyas nyi ma'i snying po la= /sangs rgyas zla ba la= /sangs rgyas 'od 'phro la=/ /sangs rgyas 'od bzang la= /sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa la= /sangs rgyas skar rgyal la= /sangs rgyas rab gsal la= /sangs rgyas phreng thogs la= /sangs rgyas yon tan 'od la= /sangs rgyas don gzigs la=/ /7 sangs rgyas mar me la= /sangs rgyas mthu ldan la= /sangs rgyas sman pa la= /sangs rgyas des pa la= /sangs rgyas mdzod spu la= /sangs rgyas brtan ldan la= /sangs rgyas lha'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas gdul dka' la= /sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas sgra gcan la=/ /7 sangs rgyas tshogs ldan la=/sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas tshigs brtan la= /sangs rgyas mi 'gying la=/sangs rgyas 'od mdzad la=/sangs rgyas lhun po chen po la=

/sangs rgyas rdo rje la=/sangs rgyas sdom can la=/sangs rgyas mi bsnyengs pa la= /sangs rgyas rin chen la=/ /7 sangs rgyas padma'i spyan la=/ sangs rgyas stobs lnga la=/sangs rgyas me tog 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas ye shes dgyes la= /sangs rgyas gzi chen la= /sangs rgyas tshangs pa la= /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la= /sangs rgyas klus byin la= /sangs rgyas brtan par gshegs la= /sangs rgyas mthong ba don yod la=/ /7 sangs rgyas brtson 'grus byin la= /sangs rgyas bzang skyong la= /sangs rgyas dga' bo la= /sangs rgyas 'chi med la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas rgyal ba la= /sangs rgyas chos ldan la= /sangs rgyas mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas kha lo bsgyur ba la= /sangs rgyas dgyes par gshegs pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas chu lha la= /sangs rgyas yon tan yan lag la= /sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po la= /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la=/ sangs rgyas 'brug sgra la phyag= /sangs rgyas sems legs la= /sangs rgyas yid bzang la= /sangs rgyas dri med la= /sangs rgyas zla ba la= /sangs rgyas grags chen la=/ /7 sangs rgyas gtsug na nor bu la= /sangs rgyas drag shul la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i stabs la= /sangs rgyas ljon pa la= /sangs rgyas rnam rgyal can la= /sangs rgyas shes rab brtsegs la= /sangs rgyas legs gnas la= /sangs rgyas blo gros la= /sangs rgyas yan lag skyes la= /sangs rgyas blo mtha' yas la=/ /7 sangs rgyas gzugs bzang la= /sangs rgyas mkhyen ldan la= / sangs rgyas 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs brtan la= /sangs rgyas bkra shis la= /sangs rgyas bden pa'i tog la= /sangs rgyas padma la= /sangs rgyas sred med bu la= /sangs rgyas lag bzang la= /sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung gnas la=/ / 7 sangs rgyas yon tan 'od 'phro la= /sangs rgyas tshangs byin la= /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas la= /sangs rgyas lha'i me tog la= /sangs rgyas don legs sems pa la=

/sangs rgyas chos kyi dbang phyug la= /sangs rgyas blo gros la= /sangs rgyus spobs pa brtsegs pa la= /sangs rgyas rdo rje rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas phan bzhed la=/ /7 sangs rgyas rnam rol ldan la= /sangs rgyas mun dang bral ba la= /sangs rgyas sgra gcan lha la= /sangs rgyas ri bo'i rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas tshogs can la= /sangs rgyas rin chen snying po la= /sangs rgyas shin tu mthor gshegs la= /sangs rgyas skar rgyal la= /sangs rgyas ru ring la= /sangs rgyas yon tan grag la=/ /7 sangs rgyas nyi zla la= /sangs rgyas nyi 'od la= /sangs rgyas skar mkhan la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i tog la= /sangs rgyas dus mkhyen rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po la= /sangs rgyas srid mtha' gzigs pa la= /sangs rgyas glog gi 'od la= /sangs rgyas gser gyi ri bo sedge'i byin la= /sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan la=/ /7 sangs rgyas mchog dga' grags pa la= /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus brtan pa la= /sangs rgyas grags rdzogs la= /sangs rgyas bsnyengs bral la= /sangs rgyas mchod 'os lha la= /sangs rgyas sgron chen la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'od la=/ sangs rgyas spos dri zhim po la= /sangs rgyas yon tan mchog 'dzin la= /sangs rgyas mun bral la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i 'gram la= /sangs rgyas rin chen grags la= /sangs rgyas skyon rab zhi ba la= /sangs rgyas bdud rtsi 'chang la= /sangs rgyas mi'i zla ba la= /sangs rgyas shin tu gzigs la= /sangs rgyas rab brgyan la= /sangs rgyas nor 'od la= /sangs rgyas ri bo brtsegs pa'i tog la= /sangs rgyas chos kyi 'byung gnas don nges ldan la=/ /7 sangs rgyas chos byin la= /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas la= /sangs rgyas skye dbang mtshungs pa la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i stabs gshegs la= /sangs rgyas blo gnas la= /sangs rgyas gdugs mdzes la= /sangs rgyas gtso bo la= /sangs rgyas shin tu 'phags pa'i dpal la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i sgra la=/

sangs rgyas rnam par rol ldan la=/ /7 sangs rgyas klu 'od la= /sangs rgyas me tog ri la= /sangs rgyas klu dga' la= /sangs rgyas spos kyi dbang phyug la= /sangs rgyas shin tu grags pa la= /sangs rgyas stobs lha la= /sangs rgyas yon tan 'phreng ldan la= /sangs rgyas klu'i lag la= /sangs rgyas mig rgyan la= /sangs rgyas legs par sbyangs pa'i blo la=/ /7 sangs rgyas zil gnon ye shes la= /sangs rgyas mtha' las spyan la= /sangs rgyas bden pa gsung la= /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od la= /sangs rgyas nges blo la= /sangs rgyas mtha' yas gzugs la= /sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad la= /sangs rgyas rin chen tog la= /sangs rgyas the tshom spangs la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'das pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas don yod rnam par gnon pa la= /sangs rgyas tog mdzad la= /sangs rgyas me tog rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la= /sangs rgyas gzi brjid chen po la= /sangs rgyas don mdzad la= /sangs rgyas grags pa mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas rin chen lha la= /sangs rgyas don gnas mkhyen la= /sangs rgyas blo rdzogs la=/ /7 sangs rgyas mya ngan med la= /sangs rgyas dri bral la= /sangs rgyas tshangs lha la= /sangs rgyas sa'i dbang phyug la= /sangs rgyas me tog spyan la= /sangs rgyas rnam 'byed sku= /sangs rgyas chos 'od la= /sangs rgyas kun gzigs la= /sangs rgyas yon tan 'od gsal la= /sangs rgyas dri med zla ba'i zhal la=/ /(2) sangs rgyas rin chen 'od la= /sangs rgyas rin chen tog la= /sangs rgyas grags pa'i bla ma la= /sangs rgyas 'od byed la= /sangs rgyas gzi brjid dpag med la= /sangs rgyas dus mkhyen la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i sku la= /sangs rgyas mkhas blo la= /sangs rgyas rgyal dka' la= /sangs rgyas yon tan phung po la=/ /7 sangs rgyas zla ba'i tog la= /sangs rgyas mthu thob pa la= /sangs rgyas mthu rtsal mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas zla ba la= /sangs rgyas dri med la= /sangs rgyas don kun gzigs pa la=

/sangs rgyas dpa' bo la= /sangs rgyas 'byor ldan la= /sangs rgyas bsod nams la= /sangs rgyas sgron ma la=/ /7 sangs rgyas yon tan 'od 'phro la= /sangs rgyas blo yangs la= /sangs rgyas legs skyes la= /sangs rgyas nor lha la= /sangs rgyas yid gnyis spong ba la= /sangs rgyas 'dzin pa dpag med la= /sangs rgyas mchog sred la= /sangs rgyas choms med la= /sangs rgyas mi gnas la= /sangs rgyas der gnas la=/ /7 sangs rgyas tshogs can gtso bo la= /sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas phal chen la= /sangs rgyas rgyal la= /sangs rgyas gzi brjid mtha' yas la= /sangs rgyas don gyi blo gros la= /sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po la phyag= /sangs rgyas tha ba spangs la= /sangs rgyas rims nad med la= /sangs rgyas legs byin la=/ /7 sangs rgyas grags byin la= /sangs rgyas me tog byin la= /sangs rgyas skyes bus sbyin la= /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sde la= /sangs rgyas phal chen byin la= /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i blo gros la= /sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po la phyag la= /sangs phyag sred med la= /sangs rgyas nges pa la= /sangs rgyas mi tshugs pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas nyi zla la= /sangs rgyas glog gi tog la= /sangs rgyas mchod pa la= /sangs rgyas dpal sbas la= /sangs rgyas ye shes nyi ma la= /sangs rgyas don grub la= /sangs rgyas lhun po brtsegs pa la=/ sangs rgyas dgra 'dul la= /sangs rgyas padma la= /sangs rgyas dgra bcom grags pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas ye shes 'gros la= /sangs rgyas nyon mongs bral la phyag= /sangs rgyas 'dam bu la= /sangs rgyas spos bzang la= /sangs rgyas yul 'khor rangs la= /sangs rgyas lha grags la= /sangs rgyas srid mtha' gzigs la= /sangs rgyas zla ba la= /sangs rgyas sgra gcan la= /sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba la=/ /7 sangs rgyas sedge'i rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas bsam gtan dgyes la= /sangs rgyas rdzogs ldan la= /sangs rgyas rnam rol la= /sangs rgyas yon tan rin chen la=

/sangs rgyas dgra bcom grags pa la= /sangs rgyas pa dngos la= /sangs rgyas mdzod spu ldan la= /sangs rgyas spobs grags la= /sangs rgyas rdo rje nor bu la=/ /7 sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la= /sangs rgyas nor bu bkod pa la= /sangs rgyas dbang chen la= /sangs rgyas yon tan 'byung gnas la= /sangs rgyas lhun po grags pa la= /sangs rgyas 'od zer bcu pa la= /sangs rgyas ma smad la= /sangs rgyas glang po'i 'gros la= /sangs rgyas yid 'thad la= /sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba la=/ /7 sangs rgyas zhi ba la= /sangs rgyas rab gsal rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas kha lo bsgyur la= /sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dbang phyug la= /sangs rgyas gtsug na rin chen la= /sangs rgyas bsnyengs bral la= /sangs rgyas rin chen snying po la= /sangs rgyas zla ba'i zhal la= /sangs rgyas dri med grags pa la= /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i gzi brjid la=/ /(3)sangs rgyas dga' ba'i tog la= /sangs rgyas sgra gcan lha la= /sangs rgyas tshod bzang la= /sangs rgyas lha dga' la= /sangs rgyas rin chen phung po la= /sangs rgyas mdzes par gshegs pa la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i phyogs pa la= /sangs rgyas shin tu mthor gshegs la= /sangs rgyas skye dbang la= /sangs rgyas blo gros bzang po la=/ /7 sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'od la= /sangs rgyas rin chen gzi brjid la= /sangs rgyas skal ldan shin rta la= /sangs rgyas kun rgyal la= /sangs rgyas dga' ba bkod pa la= /sangs rgyas stegs mdzad la= /sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po la=/ sangs rgyas blo gros 'od 'phro la= /sangs rgyas ri bo'i rgyal mtshan la= /sangs rgyas spos bzang la=/ /7 sangs rgyas chos brtan la= /sangs rgyas gzi brjid drag shul la= /sangs rgyas chos kyi nor bu la= /sangs rgyas bzang byin la= /sangs rgyas bde gshegs zla ba la= /sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbyangs la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i zla ba la= /sangs rgyas dpal la= /sangs rgyas legs skyes la= /sangs rgyas thub med tshogs la= /sangs rgyas grags pa'i bshes gnyen la=

/sangs rgyas bden pa la= /sangs rgyas dka' thub chen po la= /sangs rgyas lhun po'i 'od zer la=/ sangs rgyas yon tan brtsegs pa la= /sangs rgyas mchod grags la= /sangs rgyas chos grags la= /sangs rgyas sbyin 'od la= /sangs rgyas glog 'byin la= /sangs rgyas bden gsum la=/ /7 sangs rgyas 'tsho byed la=/ sangs rgyas na tshod bzang po la= /sangs rgyas legs pa'i tshogs can la= /sangs rgyas rnam nges blo gros la= /sangs rgyas srid mtha' nor bu'i spos la= /sangs rgyas rgyal bas dgyes pa la= /sangs rgyas sedge'i 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la= /sangs rgyas grags mchog la= /sangs rgyas thugs rab gzhungs pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas nor bu'i zla ba la= /sangs rgyas drag shul 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs thub med la= /sangs rgyas 'phros mchod la= /sangs rgyas nor bu'i tshogs la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bla ma la= /sangs rgyas glang chen sedge'i la= /sangs rgyas zla ba la=/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'od zer la= /sangs rgyas sgra gcan sbed pa la=/ /7 sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho la= /sangs rgyas 'od zer ldan pa la= /sangs rgyas rab tu zhi stabs la= /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bzang po la= /sangs rgyas mya ngan med la= /sangs rgyas shugs bcu pa la= /sangs rgyas stobs dgyes la= /sangs rgyas mthu dpal la= /sangs rgyas mthu thob la= /sangs rgyas mthu chen la=/ /7 sangs rgyas yon tan snying po la= /sangs rgyas bden par spyod pa la= /sangs rgyas dge mchog rgyal po la= /sangs rgyas skar rgyal la= /sangs rgyas 'od zer chen po la= /sangs rgyas glog 'od la=/sangs rgyas yon tan rgya chen la= /sangs rgyas rin po che la= /sangs rgyas dpal 'od la= /sangs rgyas bdud 'dul la=/ /7 sangs rgyas go bgos la=/ sangs rgyas sedge'i phyag la= /sangs rgyas me tog bzang po la= /sangs rgyas rin chen mthon po la= /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la= /sangs rgyas sa 'dzin la= /sangs rgyas don blo mnga' ba la=

de dag gi 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ji snyed mchis pa thams cad la'ang phyag 'tshal zhing*/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ 7 /skabs 'dir sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyi mtshan sogs gang mos brjod kyang chog go /bdag la bdog pa'i yo byad rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na mchis pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad kyang 'bul lo/ /bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung thams cad mthol lo/ /'chags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyis bskrun pa'i dge tshogs mtha' dag la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor par bskul lo/ /de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i legs tshogs kun dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dang lhan cig du sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /ji srid du kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog ma thob kyi bar de srid skye ba thams cad du'ang dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi'i lus rnam par thob nas dam pa'i chos mtha' dag la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'jug pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig khyad par du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas 'byung 'gyur thams cad kyi dus su de dag gi 'khor gyi mchog tu gyur nas de rnams kyi dam pa'i chos thams cad legs par 'dzin nus par gyur cigade'i mthus sangs rgyas stong po thams cad kyi zhing gi snod bcud kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa kun dang*/ 'khor gyi grangs dang sku tshe'i tshad ci tsam pa dang*/ chos bstan pa gang gis sems can ji snyed cig smin cing grol bar mdzad pa mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa de lta bu bdag nyid kyis nges par 'grub par gyur cig/

//༈ rmad byung sras bcas sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas de rnams kyi mtshan nas gus pas brjod pa sogs byas na/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ ngan song gsum dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas de rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa zhig yod do/ /spyir mdo sde las sangs rgyas byang sems gcig gi mtshan brjod na'ang las sgrib mang po 'dag nus pa sogs kyi phan yon yod par bshad pas/ sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan brjod cing gsol ba 'debs par byed na lta ci smos snyam ste 'di la 'bad pa ni/ las dang po pa'i nyams len gyi snying por shes par bya'o// //smras pa/ tshul 'di mdo sde bskal pa bzang po dang*/ /kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī yis/ /mdzad pa'i bskal bzang rgyan gyi phreng ba gnyis/ /bsdur nas brtson pa chen pos legs par sbyar/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa'i mtsho chen las/ /kun nas 'khrungs pa'i dge legs kunda'i gnyen/ /rab tu dkar ba gang zhig mchis pa des/ /'gro kun nyes mun stug po zhi gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sngar gnas brtan blo bzang dam chos kyis 'di ltar sgrigs pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba bzhin co ne'i khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris nas bar thung du brkos zin kyang phyis dad 'byor ldan pa rgya mtsho skyabs kyis 'di nyid ded kyi gsung 'bum du 'jug pa dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi ched du kho bos par ring du brko bar bya'o zhes khas blangs te par du bsgrugs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ 'go pa tho lo pa/ rnam rgyal tsho/ rgya mtsho skyabs/ rin chen sman/ lha mo tsho/ tshe dbang tsho/ chos skyong tshe ring*/ shes rab bkra shis/ don grub bkra shis sogs sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/
